audience: finance teams and bookkeepers who check sales and purchase documents in Cegid Jasmin

useCases.title: Review the sales invoices of a customer
useCases.text: Find the customer in the party list, then list its sales invoices, newest first. Open one invoice to read its lines and taxes.

useCases.title: Check the due dates of supplier invoices
useCases.text: List the supplier invoices received, with supplier, date, due date and status. Open one invoice to read its lines and taxes.

useCases.title: Look up a sales order by its number
useCases.text: Open a sales order by its document number and series. Read its document lines to check quantities and prices.

useCases.title: Match customer payments to invoices
useCases.text: List the customer receipts with their amount and payment method. Open one receipt to see the invoices it settles.

useCases.title: Review credit and debit notes
useCases.text: List the sales credit and debit notes, then open one to read its document data.
